compliance_risks.could_misstate: Describing any of these as insurance. Describing a discount program as insurance is a material misrepresentation. Six are named as discount programs; the rest are simply unknown, including products whose names sound insured such as AD&D, Critical Care, Term Life and Fusion Dental.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not describe AssistPro, GapSupport, Ameriguard, Prime Health Pass, Express Health Tools or HealthAssist as insurance or as coverage - the portal names each of them a Discount. Do not describe the remaining 36 at all until typed. Do not say 'PPO' about Allstate Dental PPO in a way implying major medical.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Nothing product-specific. An add-on should not be described until its type is established.

source.sec: NEO product list; registry entries with product_type NEEDS_MANUAL_VERIFICATION

compliance_risks.verified_fact: 43 add-on products are listed on the NEO platform. NONE has a document in Drive. 36 of them could not be assigned a product type from any available source. Six are typed as discount programs solely because the portal's own product name contains the word 'Discount'.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Before mentioning any add-on by name on a recorded call.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Classifying any product from its name. Doing so produces errors in both directions - calling insurance a membership, and calling a service a discount.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never type or describe a product from its name. Read the Info page.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Nothing client-facing. This is an internal rule.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Product names in this portfolio are unreliable indicators of product type IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. 'AWA SimpleShield Membership Plan' is fixed indemnity insurance. 'Prime Health Pass Discount' is described on its own page as a Diagnostic Services Product delivering services. Between April and September NEO inserted the word 'Membership' into four Safe Guard product names without any evident change of type. Meanwhile 'AssistPro Discount' genuinely is a discount program.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Before any add-on is described on a call, and before any tooling assigns it a category.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: For any product in this group, do not answer a coverage, exclusion, waiting-period or pre-existing question on a recorded call from portal material alone. Obtain the carrier document first.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: 51 of the 80 products on the NEO agent storefront have no brochure, certificate or policy document attached anywhere in the enrolment system. For those products the NEO reference page is the only available source, and four of those pages carry a limitations or exclusions heading with no text beneath it.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: The monthly cost quoted on a recorded call must include this fee, or the fee must be stated separately before the payment authorisation. Quoting the product page price alone understates what the client will be charged.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: A 3.5% credit-card or ACH processing fee applies to every payment and appears only in the platform TERMS panel, which more than half the product pages do not display at all.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not tell a client a scheduled benefit amount will be paid in full without qualifying it by the URC limit.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: A platform-level usual, reasonable and customary cap applies on top of every product's stated benefits and appears only in the TERMS panel.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Every recorded verification must cover all four elements. Omitting the recurring monthly amount or the automatic draft is a breach of the platform agreement, not only a compliance risk.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The platform agreement requires an electronic signature or a recorded verification script with every sale, and specifies the four things the member must be shown to understand: the product, its benefits, the initial payment, and the recurring monthly amount drafted automatically.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Disclose to any client on a tight account that a single failed draft can end the plan.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: A dishonoured payment can result in forfeiture of the plan with no liability on anyone's part, expressly including where the dishonour was inadvertent or without cause.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never describe NEO as the insurance company. Name the carrier for the specific product.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Neo Insurance Solutions is an agency and platform, not the insurer, and disclaims liability for agents' conduct and representations.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Disclose the 3.5% card/ACH processing fee on every sale regardless of which page the client was shown. Do not rely on the panel a given product page happens to display.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The storefront serves two different versions of the NEO enrolment agreement. The shorter one, on the MDLive pages, omits the 3.5% processing fee, the contact and electronic-document consents, the HIPAA statement and the member signature block.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not tell a client 'the terms are on the page'. Establish which agreement governs their enrolment, and disclose the 3.5% processing fee regardless of which panel their product displays.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Four different NEO enrolment agreements are in simultaneous circulation on the storefront, and most product pages show none at all.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Answer exclusion questions for these four variants from the TERMS panel list, which is policy language, not from the INFORMATION summary.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The complete 24-item carrier exclusion list for these plans is in the TERMS panel, not the INFORMATION panel. The INFORMATION panel's own exclusion summary is expressly non-exhaustive and omits, among others, the unlicensed-driver exclusion, the VA hospital exclusion and the 31-day National Guard rule.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: State the seven-day waiting period whenever the daily benefit is quoted. A three-day accident admission pays $0.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The hospital indemnity benefit pays nothing for the first seven days of an accident-related confinement, and most hospital stays are shorter than that.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never describe these as hospital plans. They are accident-only.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Hospital indemnity under these plans is payable only when a covered accident causes the confinement. Sickness confinement is not covered.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Disclose this before close. The client can lose coverage without ever being told directly.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Notice of termination goes to the Association, and that is deemed notice to every member. GTL will not notify the member individually.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Answer exclusion questions from the brochure, not the portal. A client expecting cover for a back strain or a hernia is not covered.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The carrier brochure excludes repetitive motion injuries, strains, hernia, tendonitis, bursitis and heat exhaustion that are not related to a specific Injury. This exclusion does NOT appear in the enrolment system's TERMS panel.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Worth naming on the call for any client whose licence is suspended or expired.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: No benefit is payable where the insured was the operator of a motor vehicle without a current and valid licence, except in a Driver's Education Program.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never quote one of these two products from the other's material. Establish which product is being enrolled by its page id, then quote from that product's own brochure. Do not tell a Safe Guard 100 client they have paralysis cover.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: AWA Safe Guard 100 and AWA Safe Guard Accident Membership Plan $100,000 SA have byte-identical NEO pages and the same price, but their carrier brochures carry different benefit schedules - paralysis benefits and a doubled hearing benefit on the SA product only.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Until the PDFs are filed, any compliance challenge to a benefit statement on these products can be answered only with the ledger's citations, not with the underlying document. Treat filing them as outstanding remediation, not housekeeping.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Ten of the eleven linked brochures are READ and fully extracted into the ledger, but the PDF files themselves are not in Drive. The documents behind 25 live variants therefore exist in this project only as extracted facts, not as retrievable source documents.

exclusions.full_24_item_list.v: 1. Treatment, services or supplies that are not medically necessary, not prescribed by a doctor as necessary to treat an injury, determined experimental or investigational, received without charge or legal obligation to pay, received from persons employed or retained by any family member, or not specifically listed as Covered Charges. 2. Injury by acts of war, declared or not. 3. Injury while travelling or flying by air except as a fare-paying passenger and not as pilot or crew on a regularly scheduled commercial airline. 4. Injury paid by Worker's Compensation, Employer Liability law or Occupational Disease Act or Law. 5. Dental treatment except as specifically stated. 6. Injury while committing or attempting to commit a felony. 7. Prescription drugs except as specifically stated. 8. Suicide or attempted suicide while sane or insane. 9. Intentionally self-inflicted injury. 10. Loss from being legally intoxicated or under the influence of alcohol as defined by the state or jurisdiction where the injury occurs. 11. Loss from being under the influence of drugs or narcotics unless administered on a doctor's advice. 12. Injury while on active duty service in any armed forces; reserve or National Guard active duty for training is not excluded unless it extends beyond 31 days. 13. Injury flying in an ultralight, hang gliding, parachuting or bungee-cord jumping, or by flight in a spacecraft or craft designed for navigation above the earth's atmosphere. 14. Injury while driving or riding on vehicles for off-road use including all terrain vehicles. 15. Injury where the insured is the operator and does not possess a current and valid motor vehicle operator's licence, except in a Driver's Education Program. 16. Treatment in any Veteran's Administration or federal hospital except where there is a legal obligation to pay. 17. Cosmetic surgery except reconstructive surgery on an injured part of the body. 18. Covered charges incurred outside the United States or its possessions. 19. Competing in motor sports races or competitions. 20. Competing in water sports races or competitions. 21. Testing cars or trucks on any racetrack or speedway. 22. Handling, storing or transporting explosives. 23. Scaling up cliffs or mountain walls. 24. Spelunking.

exclusions.full_27_item_list.v: 1. Treatment, services or supply which are not Medically Necessary; are not prescribed by a Doctor as necessary to treat an Injury; are determined to be Experimental/Investigational in nature; are received without charge or legal obligation to pay; are received from persons employed or retained by any Family Member unless otherwise specified; or are not specifically listed as Covered Charges in the Policy. 2. Injury by acts of war, whether declared or not. 3. Injury received while traveling or flying by air, except as a fare-paying passenger and not as pilot or crew member, on a regularly scheduled commercial airline. 4. Injury paid by Worker's Compensation, Employer Liability law or Occupational Disease Act or Law. 5. Dental treatment, except as specifically stated. 6. Injury sustained while committing or attempting to commit a felony. 7. Prescription Drugs except as specifically stated. 8. Suicide or attempted suicide while sane or insane. 9. Intentionally self-inflicted Injury. 10. Loss resulting from being legally intoxicated or under the influence of alcohol as defined by the laws of the state or jurisdiction in which the Injury occurs. 11. Loss resulting from being under the influence of any drugs or narcotic unless administered on the advice of a Doctor. 12. Injury which occurs while on active duty service in any armed forces; Reserve or National Guard active duty for training is not excluded unless it extends beyond 31 days. 13. Injury sustained flying in an ultra light, hang gliding, parachuting or bungee-cord jumping, by flight in a space craft or any craft designed for navigation above or beyond the earth's atmosphere. 14. Injury sustained while driving or riding on vehicles for off-road use including but not limited to all terrain vehicles. 15. Injury sustained where You are the operator and does not possess a current and valid motor vehicle operator's license, except in a Driver's Education Program. 16. Treatment in any Veteran's Administration or federal Hospital, except if there is a legal obligation to pay. 17. Cosmetic surgery, except for reconstructive surgery on an injured part of the body. 18. Covered Charges incurred outside of the United States or its possessions. 19. Competing in motor sports races or competitions. 20. Competing in water sports races or competitions. 21. Testing cars/trucks on any racetrack or speedway. 22. Handling, storing or transporting explosives. 23. Scaling up cliffs or mountain walls. 24. Spelunking (exploring caves). 24. [sic - the source numbers two items 24] Handling or working with dangerous animals. 26. Injury sustained while participating in a rodeo. 27. Repetitive motion injuries, strains, hernia, tendonitis, bursitis and heat exhaustion not related to a specific Injury.
